crossRefs.note: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.

translations.web: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
translations.bsb: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
translations.kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
translations.asv: I beheld the treacherous, and was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.
